name: Hind Rectifiers Ltd
about: HRL  manufactures power electronic equipment such as converters, inverters, propulsion system, rectifiers and railway transformation equipment like traction transformer for locomotive, motors, various types of panels for locomotive  switch board cabinet, regulated battery charger,  inverters and modular pantry. The manufacturing facilities are in Mumbai and Nasik, Maharashtra, and Dehradun, Uttarakhand, and its registered office is in Mumbai.
keyPoints:
Company Overview[1]
Established in 1958 in collaboration with Westinghouse Brake & Signal Co. Ltd (UK), Hind Rectifiers specializes in design, manufacturing,  and supply of electrical and electronic equipment. Its core focus lies in power conversion products, catering primarily to the railway and industrial sectors.

cons: Stock is trading at 13.4 times its book value
